title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-27
lineage: SBD> Master Reel (but see note)> Dat (48k)> Dat (Sony D8)> RME Hammerfall Digiface> Sony Vaio C1VP> Samplitude v7.02 Professional> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear Miller soundboard captures a legendary Watkins Glen ’73 soundcheck with an epic Jam > Wharf Rat and soaring Bird Song.
ai_review.review: This upgraded soundboard recording by Charlie Miller delivers exceptional clarity, letting the famed July‑27‑1973 Watkins Glen soundcheck shine. Reviewers rave about the blazing Jam that flows into Wharf Rat – a highlight that even hints at Fire on the Mountain – as well as a beautiful Bird Song segment. The performance is praised for its loose yet tight improvisation, and the audio quality is described as crisp, clear and far superior to earlier sources.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (average ~4.7) and enthusiastic comments about both the musical performance and Miller's superb soundboard upgrade.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Upgraded Miller SBD provides crisp, clear audio with excellent instrument separation; a half‑step pitch shift is noted but does not detract from overall fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A short, spontaneous soundcheck that morphs into an impromptu concert; the jam builds dramatically, leading into a powerful Wharf Rat and punctuated by a soaring Bird Song, showcasing the band’s tight yet free‑flowing improvisational chemistry.

band_member_comments.Phil: Praised as 'absolutely insane', highlighting his energetic bass lines that drove the jam.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's electric piano burst around the 13‑minute mark is celebrated for adding fire and excitement to the improvisation.
